decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom extends the firm's decades of scanning-phantom and dosimetry know-how to a niche, research-intensive segment where its absorptive capacity and partnerships with proton centres let it refine the product, though it was only mentioned rather than featured in 2019, which signals some uncertainty.
Small volume ionization chambers sit at the core of the firm's dosimetry expertise and accredited calibration capability, so it can readily interpret field results and improve the product.
This second small volume chamber builds directly on existing chamber design knowledge and serves growing small-field and stereotactic QA needs, giving it a strong fit with established competencies.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a staple of the firm's core business, has long-lasting demand, and needs little new knowledge to sustain.
Relative dosimetry chambers pair with the firm's water phantoms and software, so they reinforce the integrated QA platform and draw on deep in-house knowledge.
Thimble chambers are classic reference dosimetry instruments tied to the firm's accredited calibration services, which makes them low-risk to keep and closely related to what it already knows.
